preheader: US job growth slows to 29,000, Chip City shuts down, and OpenAI turns ChatGPT into an app platform.

lead.headline: US job growth slows to just 29,000, complicating the Fed's next move
lead.body: The US economy added only 29,000 nonfarm jobs in September, coming in much lower than expected. This sharp slowdown makes it highly likely the Federal Reserve will hold interest rates steady at its late October meeting, rather than raising them again.
lead.why: As a business student, keeping an eye on interest rates is key. Higher rates make borrowing more expensive for startups and corporations, which can slow down hiring and lower stock valuations.

stories.headline: Cookie chain Chip City shuts down all locations nationwide
stories.body: Despite rapid expansion and millions of dollars in backing from a top hospitality investment firm, Chip City has closed all its stores. The company blamed tough economic conditions for the sudden shutdown.
stories.why: This is a classic case study in the risks of scaling too fast on venture money. For your future startup or investing plans, it shows that rapid growth without a stable foundation can quickly lead to collapse.

stories.headline: LA's mansion tax blocked thousands of homes and cost millions, report says
stories.body: A new report reveals that Los Angeles's controversial tax on luxury real estate has blocked the construction of 9,100 homes. It also wiped out 16,650 construction jobs and cost $452 million in revenue.
stories.why: Understanding how taxes and regulations impact real-world markets is a core part of business strategy. This shows how policies intended to tax the wealthy can sometimes backfire and hurt the broader economy.

stories.headline: OpenAI turns ChatGPT into an app platform with third-party integrations
stories.body: OpenAI is expanding ChatGPT so users can discover, launch, and use other software directly within the chatbot. The update allows users to interact with third-party tools without ever leaving the ChatGPT interface.
stories.why: This platform shift creates massive opportunities for builders. If you want to launch a startup, building apps that live inside ChatGPT's ecosystem could be a great way to reach millions of users quickly.

stories.headline: Trump establishes 'Super Intelligence Force' to evaluate AI risks
stories.body: A new White House task force, led by Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton, will assess the risks of artificial intelligence. The group will produce a report outlining the federal government's responsibilities in managing AI.
stories.why: As AI becomes more regulated, compliance will be a major focus for tech companies and consulting firms. Knowing how the government plans to oversee AI will help you advise future clients on risk management.

stories.headline: McKinsey predicts AI will destroy 11 million jobs but create even more
stories.body: A McKinsey report estimates that AI will displace about 11 million US workers, or 7% of the workforce. However, the firm expects AI to ultimately create more jobs than it eliminates, though helping workers transition to these new roles will be a major challenge.
stories.why: The job market is shifting rapidly. Focusing on high-level strategy, consulting, and relationship-building will help protect your career from being automated.

stories.headline: Only 7% of companies have successfully scaled AI, McKinsey finds
stories.body: A McKinsey study found that while 88% of organizations use AI, only 7% have successfully scaled it. Experts argue that applying AI to broken, fragmented business processes just speeds up the fragmentation rather than fixing the underlying issues.
stories.why: This is pure gold for a future consultant. Your job won't just be recommending AI tools; it will be helping companies redesign their workflows first so that technology actually works.

stories.headline: UC Irvine men's basketball to host UNM Lobos in December
stories.body: The UNM Lobos' upcoming basketball schedule includes a highly anticipated game at UC Irvine on December 18. The matchup is expected to be a key test for both teams right before the SoCal Challenge.

stories.headline: World No. 1 Jannik Sinner withdraws from Shanghai Masters
stories.body: Jannik Sinner has officially pulled out of the 2026 Rolex Shanghai Masters as he continues to recover from a long-term left knee injury. The Italian star apologized to fans on Instagram, extending his absence from the ATP Tour.

term.name: Federal Funds Rate
term.definition: The interest rate at which commercial banks lend extra reserves to each other overnight. Set by the Federal Reserve, it influences borrowing costs across the entire economy, from credit cards to business loans. When job growth slows down, the Fed often keeps this rate steady or lowers it to encourage borrowing and boost the economy.

serve.headline: DRISHTI CPS Foundation partners with IFCI Venture to fund tech startups
serve.body: The DRISHTI CPS Foundation at IIT Indore has signed an agreement with IFCI Venture Capital Funds. The partnership aims to connect early-stage, technology-driven startups with funding schemes, investors, and wider commercial markets.
